description: Perform general image editing with provider, prompt, resolution, aspect ratio, and quality controls.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the image to edit. The image must be between 300 and 4096 pixels in both width and height, and its width-to-height ratio must be between 0.4 and 2.5.

fields.name: prompt
fields.example: make the background pure white and keep the product unchanged

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Image model. Supported values: BANANA, BANANA_2, BANANA_PRO, WAN2_7, QWEN_IMAGE_3_PRO, SEEDREAM5, GPT_2_IMAGE, or AIDRAW_EDIT.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4.

fields.name: supplyType
fields.description: Generation route. Supported values: eco or stable. Defaults to stable.

fields.name: needOptimize
fields.description: Whether the prompt should be optimized upstream.

fields.name: template
fields.description: Optional Nexscope editing template. Supported values: white-background, product-main-image-retouching, scene-generation, poster-design, add-person-or-object, change-animal, flat-lay-apparel, 3d-apparel, mannequin-to-model, cartoon-illustration, body-reshape, change-style, remove-element, remove-text, remove-watermark, add-watermark.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Optional traffic or product source code.

fields.name: quality
fields.description: GPT Image quality only. Supported values: low, medium, or high. Defaults to medium.

example.prompt: make the background pure white and keep the product unchanged
